app.title: Aion PAK Manager
app.refreshListsHint: Refreshes the PAKS and UnPAKEDS lists

settings.title: Settings
settings.rememberBoundsHint: Remember the app's last position and size.
settings.checkIdle: Click Check to look for updates.
settings.cpuEffortExplanation: Choose how many logical cores you want the app to use. The more cores you use, the fewer will remain available for normal computer use. Selecting "Extreme" may cause the computer to stutter or slow down while the app is running an action.
settings.recountCountsHint: Lists keep the last count in settings.json. Use this to clear the cache and recount everything (useful after large changes).
settings.recountStarted: Recount started — lists update as each folder finishes.

pak.title: PAKS:
pak.subIndividual: List of {pakDir} (PAKs) for individual extraction. UnPAK writes to {unpakedDir}.
pak.subFolder: Extract full folder (recursive) to {unpakedDir}: each .pak's files are extracted straight into the folder (no name.pak/ folders) and a single .db inside the extracted folder (named after the folder) records each pak and its files.
pak.emptyEntries: No .pak files or folders found in {pakDir}.
pak.openPaksHint: Open the PAKS files folder in the system.
pak.viewContentsHint: View the PAK files before extracting
pak.viewRepakedContentsHint: View the files of the reconstructed PAK.
pak.addFolderHint: Add all files in this folder
pak.removeFolderHint: Remove all files in this folder
pak.resizeHint: Drag to resize; double-click to reset
pak.viewFolderContentsHint: View the files inside this folder.
pak.decryptAfterHint: When checked, decrypt starts immediately after UnPAK finishes.
pak.createPakFolderHint: When checked, each .pak is extracted into a folder with the same name as the .pak, instead of into the location where the .pak files sit. The app still knows which files belong to which .pak when reconstructing — only use this if you want that separation for another reason.
pak.selectFirst: Select at least one folder or .pak file to extract.
pak.dropHint: Drag files here (or onto a folder) to add or replace them in the RePAK
pak.overwriteHint: On: files with the same name/path are replaced. Off: they are skipped.
pak.addingFilesLog: Adding {n} item(s) to the RePAK into {folder}
pak.addFailed: Failed to add to the RePAK: {error}
pak.deleteConfirmFile: Delete the file "{name}" from the RePAK?
pak.deleteConfirmFolder: Delete the folder "{name}" and all of its contents from the RePAK?
pak.deleteRootConfirmFolder: Delete the folder "{name}" and all of its contents? This cannot be undone.
pak.deleteRootConfirmFile: Delete the file "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
pak.deletingRootWait: This may take a while. Please wait…
pak.deleteFailed: Failed to delete from the RePAK: {error}
pak.overwritePromptSummary: {n} file(s) already exist in the RePAK. Confirm the replacement.
pak.overwriteConfirmBody: {n} file(s) already exist in the RePAK. Replace them?

unpaked.title: UnPAKEDS:
unpaked.sub: Folders in {unpakedDir} for Decrypt/RePAK. UnPAK creates folders without .pak; RePAK/Reconstruct writes to {repakedDir}.
unpaked.openUnpakedsHint: Open the UnPAKEDS files folder in the system.
unpaked.repaksHint: Open the RePAKEDS files folder in the system.
unpaked.selectFirstDecrypt: Select at least one folder in {dir} to decrypt.
unpaked.selectFirstRepak: Select at least one folder in {dir} to repack.
unpaked.repakedSub: Rebuilt PAKs in {repakedDir}. Drag files from the OS into the viewer to add or replace them without rebuilding the whole pak.
unpaked.dbStructureHint: Full folder extracted. Click to view the PAKs reconstruction structure.
